name: Hairpin
description: A hairpin bend - the road doubling back on itself - turning a quarter with every column.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(10% 10%, 90% 10%, 90% 46%, 34% 46%, 34% 56%, 90% 56%, 90% 90%, 10% 90%, 10% 56%, 66% 56%, 66% 46%, 10% 46%); clip-path: polygon(10% 10%, 90% 10%, 90% 46%, 34% 46%, 34% 56%, 90% 56%, 90% 90%, 10% 90%, 10% 56%, 66% 56%, 66% 46%, 10% 46%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(@x % 4 * 90)deg); transform: rotate(@calc(@x % 4 * 90)deg); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
